THE NOTIFICATION MADE BY THE HON. GOVERNOR OF NORTH WESTERN PROVINCE
Rules and Regulations issued in terms of Section 32(3) of Provincial Council Act No. 42 of 1987
I do hereby notify that the Rules and Regulations hereunder are issued in terms of Section 32(3) of Provincial Council ActNo. 42 of 1987 and will be take effect from 01.09.2019.
PESHALA JAYARATHNA BANDARA,Governor of North Western Province
26th August, 2019.
RULES AND REGULATIONS FOR SCHOOL WORK ASSISTANTS OF THE SCHOOLS IN NORTHWESTERN PROVINCE
01. The working hours for School Work Assistants shall be from 7.00 a.m. to 3.45 p.m. Provided that they may leaveafter closing of the school unless engaged in a special duty.
02. The short leave shall be 1 hour and 30 minutes from 7.00 a.m. to 8.30 a.m. or 2.15 p.m. to 3.45p.m., before lunchor after lunch, in a manner which does not affect duty.
03. Half day leave shall be 04 hours up to 11.00 a.m. or from 11.45.a.m.
04. Establishment Code and the circular concerned shall be applicable for other leave.
05. The principal must call for another female employee or a lady teacher in case of employing a female School Work

07. The principal should assign duties which assist the office functions to School Work Assistants.
08. The Department of Provincial Education shall issue Identity cards for School Work Assistants.
